title: How the worked solution walks [5, 1, 5, 3, 0]
caption: Step through it and watch the second 5: a tie can't take first place, but it still beats second.
notes: 5 beats biggest (nothing yet), so biggest becomes 5.
1 does not beat biggest 5, but beats second (nothing yet), so second becomes 1.
5 only ties biggest, so it cannot take first place. It beats second 1, so second becomes 5.
3 beats neither: it is under biggest 5 and under second 5.
0 beats neither. The list is done: 5 × 5 = 25.
